VDA_rent_prices.source_basis: NT agentūrų ir internetinių portalų nuomos kainos

geography_options.C: 10 apskričių tikras agregatas iš savivaldybių lygmens duomenų

notes: Apskričių atlyginimų serija apima visus darbuotojus, ne tik 25–30 m.; nepublikuoti kaip tiesioginio jaunimo pajamų rodiklio.
VDA oficiali pirkimo kainų serija neturi 10 apskričių aprėpties.
VDA oficiali nuomos serija apima tik 5 didžiųjų miestų savivaldybes.
Apskrities centro duomenų negalima vadinti apskrities vidurkiu.
Live/main nekeisti, kol nepasirinkta ir neužpildyta pilna geografinė metodika.
Aruodas 2025-12 benchmark: 1-room offer averages were Vilnius 484 EUR/month, Kaunas 379, Klaipėda 371; use only for rent-method validation, not as county values.
VDA/RC 1 km apartment-purchase grid (dataset 2559) is QA/diagnostic only and must not be used as the main 10-county sale-price layer.
Smart Continent BI_3 reconstructed rent is QA/diagnostic only and must not be used as the main private-rent layer.
No county-center substitution: city values cannot be relabeled as county values.
All outgoing emails, external requests and forms must be shown to the owner before sending.
Aruodas/Skelbiu aggregate-data request has NOT been sent; any future portal request must be shown to the owner first and sent only after explicit approval.
Official VDA S7R280 2024 apartment sale benchmark is available for 6 city municipalities + Lithuania only; it is validation, not a 10-county layer.
Smart Continent BI_1 is exactly generic housing EUR/m² divided by monthly net VDU; it contains no independent apartment-only price signal.

sale_layer.main_source_target: Registrų centras official 2024 apartment transaction aggregate/anonymized layer
sale_layer.geography_requirement: 60 municipalities -> 10 counties, or direct 10-county aggregate with documented method
sale_layer.current_grid_dataset: VDA / Registrų centras 1x1 km apartment purchase transaction grid (dataset 2559)
sale_layer.reason: 2024 snapshot covers only 33 municipalities / 8 counties and 516 transactions; it is a narrow subset of the full apartment market and cannot support the main 10-county sale-price layer.
sale_layer.note: Do not aggregate the 1 km grid into the publication sale layer.
sale_layer.smart_continent_bi1_formula: BI_1 = generic housing EUR/m² / monthly net VDU exactly for all 60 municipalities
sale_layer.official_vda_validation: S7R280 2024 apartment EUR/m² verified for 6 city municipalities + Lithuania

income_layer.source: Sodra open data: Vidutinės apdraustųjų pajamos
income_layer.note: Municipality income data are available in Sodra open-data exports; national 25–30 benchmark already verified.

rent_layer.main_target: 2025 private long-term 1-room apartment asking-rent layer covering all 10 counties
rent_layer.preferred_source_shape: direct county aggregates; alternatively complete municipality aggregates/raw listings with documented basket, duplicate handling and aggregation weights
rent_layer.official_validation: VDA S7R281 2025 official rent benchmark verified from ArcGIS FeatureServer for 5 largest cities
rent_layer.secondary_validation: Aruodas historical offer statistics for Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda
rent_layer.reason: 60-municipality BI_3 series has unverified municipal estimation/basket/precision and implausibly low reconstructed rents in multiple municipalities.
rent_layer.portal_request_status: NOT_SENT; draft/request may be prepared only after showing exact text to owner and receiving explicit approval

calculation_layer.strict_default: requires publication_approved sale and rent layers
blockers: 2025 private long-term 1-room asking-rent layer covering all 10 counties

income_model_2025_11.note: Savivaldybių pajamų struktūra iš Sodra 2025-11 lentelės; jaunimo lygis modeliuotas nacionaliniu 25–30 / visų visą mėnesį dirbusių santykiu; apskrities svoris — savivaldybės apdraustųjų skaičius.

validation_benchmarks_sale_offer_or_mark.usage: validation only; final sale layer must use an official RC actual-apartment-transaction aggregate/anonymized source that passes the 60-municipality/10-county methodology gate. Dataset 2559 grid remains QA only.
